prompt:
Generate a ten-second energetic realistic product-review shot from this exact opening photograph. Keep the product identity: The unboxed Coco Bear PRO kettle shown in the supplied reference: ivory-white rounded base, clear glass jug partly filled with clear water, thick ivory handle on the right, metallic collar below the jug rim, transparent lid with ivory bear-shaped knob, black rounded front control panel with Coco Bear logo, dual temperature readouts and original buttons. Keep exactly the supplied product design, shape, colors and visible controls. Do not change into a blender or coffee machine. The kettle stands on the worktop, removed from the reference transport box. Do not invent new controls or functions.
Maintain this exact room, lighting and the same one adult hand and sleeve. HANDS ONLY: no face, head, hair, shoulders, torso, full person or reflections of a face/body in any frame. The person stays entirely beyond the side edge of the picture; only hand and forearm are visible.
TARGET LOCK: track the KETTLE, not the person. Keep the kettle centered at the middle of the frame, with its complete base, spout, lid and handle within the central 80 percent of the frame, all the way to the final frame. If necessary reduce the orbit angle rather than let any part leave the image. At medium-wide camera distance, sweep visibly from front-left through the front control panel toward the handle side, a 35-45 degree arc over ten seconds. Dolly OUT five percent to preserve clear margins. Show the front and handle side while keeping the entire kettle centered. No close-up.
The motion begins immediately and stays visibly active at normal speed, smooth gimbal tracking with natural background parallax. Brief gentle ease-in and ease-out only, no long static pauses, no ultra-slow motion, no abrupt jerk. The product stays rigid, stationary on the tabletop; camera moves around it. Do not show an invented rear view or spin it 360 degrees.
The single adult hand makes a clear, natural open-palm presentation beside the kettle, with one purposeful wrist turn, then settles. Keep five realistic fingers, no extra hands and no finger crossing over the product. No pulling a full person into view; no camera movement up toward a face. Do not lift, unbox, operate, pour from or open the kettle. No speaking or lip-sync; narration is added separately.
Preserve kettle shape, handle, lid, front controls, logo and digits consistently. No morphing, moving letters, boiling steam, scene changes, subtitles or added graphics. No music, narration or sound effects. Full-screen vertical 9:16, 720p, one continuous shot at normal camera speed.
